summary: @or-sdk/markdowner preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip into a temp directory, extracts and chmods the Bun binary, and invokes execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js']) against a bundled sibling file. math_init.js is a ~728 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle using string-array rotation and randomized identifiers, whose filename (math_init.js) does not reflect the package's stated markdown-processing purpose. Fetching an alternate runtime at preinstall specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload outside of Node bypasses Node-focused install-time inspection and is not a legitimate build pattern for a markdown package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
